BiblicalUsage: Jemuel is an Israelite, a son of Simeon. In Genesis 46:10, Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad. The fuller story is told on the Jemuel profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jemuel is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
